A '''secret Republic bio-lab''' was located on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dranok]] bought a [[Flower/Legends|flower]] from a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Drug dealer|spice dealer]] that the dealer claimed was a genuine [[Murakami orchid]] stolen from the bio-lab, though in reality Dranok had been duped by the dealer.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
